CRUMB is a small bakery in Vesterbro, Copenhagen. We laminate one dough with Danish cultured butter, fold it twenty-seven times, and bake in small batches all morning. Order ahead — your bag waits at the counter, still warm.

The making

Four layers, one croissant.

01 / 04
01

The dough

Stone-milled wheat, water, salt — and a levain older than the bakery itself. Mixed at four in the afternoon, rested overnight. Never rushed, never frozen.

02

The butter

One slab of Danish cultured butter, locked inside the dough and rolled out thin. This is where the shatter comes from — butter, and only butter.

03

The fold

Three folds make twenty-seven layers. Then each croissant is shaped by hand and proofed slowly, until it holds its breath.

04

The bake

Eighteen minutes at 210 degrees. Deep amber, crisp enough to hear from the door. Out at 05:30 — and, if you ordered, straight into your bag.

Our story

Two bakers, one oven, no shortcuts.

CRUMB began in 2019, when bakers Freja Lund and Mikkel Aagaard took over a shuttered storefront on Bagerstræde — Baker Street, which felt like a sign — with one oven, one sheeter, and a stubborn idea: a croissant should be a good enough reason to get out of bed.

Everything is still made in the room behind the counter. The levain is older than the bakery. The butter comes from a single farm on Fyn. And when the day’s trays are gone, we close — a bakery should smell of baking, not of leftovers.

Good questions

Before you queue

How far ahead can I order?+

Up to the day after tomorrow — place your order by 20:00 the evening before at the latest. Same-day orders stay open until the last tray sells out, which on a sunny Saturday is usually around ten.

Where do I pick up?+

At the counter on Bagerstræde 9, Vesterbro. Give the name on the order and your CRB code — the bag is labelled, warm, and waiting. No queue, even when there is one.

Do you bake anything gluten-free?+

Honestly: not safely. Our rugbrød is naturally low in gluten, but everything is baked in one small kitchen with flour in the air. Ask at the counter and we will always tell you exactly what is in what.

Can I order for an office or an event?+

Yes — ten loaves or trays and up, two days ahead, and we plan the bake around you. Write to hej@crumb.example with the date and headcount, and Freja will answer herself.
